Mooning about through the emptier regions of the cosmos, Thanatos is surprised when the endless tedium is broken by a quiet request. At first, he ignores it, believing it to be out of his domain. However, as he takes up his scythe, a laugh bubbles through him. Cutting a way in spacetime with it, his robes flap in the breeze rising off the sea. Stepping through onto a luscious island, he is bewildered by the variety of strange creatures making their ways around him. Very few even notice his gray robes, and he silently thanks himself for negating the opacity of his scythe as he makes his way towards the water. When he sees no one looking at him, he steps out onto the water and begins walking to the edge of the archipelago. Far beyond the shore, he turns and looks back at the bustling island.

"This is just." He murmurs to himself. As he looks to his right hand, the fell sickle moon that is the blade of unbecoming begins gathering the light, shifting slowly from an obsidian outline to a sickly, muted gray blade. Thanatos squares his shoulders and raises his left arm to the waiting blade. In an swift grey blur, the blade eats into his thumb, and a drop his blood now sits upon its edge. With a grin and a flash of power in his eyes, a thunderous crack deafens all for a moment as Thanatos stands panting, his scythe dripping water from it's again transparent blade. To his right and to his left, the waves crash against a now still ring of water. Outside it, the waves are tumultuous but within the ocean is nearly flat. The trees on the island, which shook with the first shockwave, now barely move with a breeze so gentle it's unnoticeable. The air over this now still patch of water feels heavy as the god shakily inhales. With a quiet prayer to the sea life perturbed by his barrier, he leaps into the air and crashes down in the water at the center of the now still archipelago. Deep he sinks into the murky depths. When his feet hit the bottom, he draws himself together and wills the water away from himself in a small sphere. The muck that is the sea floor is noxious, but using the hilt of his scythe the god draws a circle in the mire that turns to dirt on contact. Thanatos takes his still bleeding thumb, and squeezes it over the center of the dirt circle. The blood slowly drips into the center of the circle, congealing into a blood-red stone. Thus planted in the earth, he walks around the circle, quietly chanting,

" As above, so below, through thin and thick and blood and bone. When storms rage and water rises, fear not any new surprises. Ashes to Ashes, dust to dust, transition with it is a must. As stone grows and waters still, I come of change to eat my fill"

The stone shines a white light high into the waters above, a pillar of light seen on every island. As the Lord of Transitions opens the way back into his realm, he smiles at the little red stone waiting for the presence of all growing things.

"Good luck", He bids the stone, before closing the way behind him. The bubble sits forgotten on the sea floor, waiting to bring new life.
